payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning'. The commercial question peaks twice: after the day-of briefing work (venue coordinator, MC, caterer), when a couple planning from overseas sees how much there is to manage from another time zone (secondary), and at the end of the destination weekend section, after the venue questions (primary). The closing CTA ends the post and the magazine serves readers still collecting ideas. Per the panel, accountability rests on inclusions confirmed in writing, so the primary subtext uses that line; the secondary subtext echoes the time zone bridge; the closing subtext uses 'anywhere in the world' to answer the search_visitor and uhnw concern that the page excluded readers outside Australia, without claiming who is served. Subtexts use only brand-facts lines 26, 28 and 30. All money, rate, currency, payment and booking-status wording is left out, matching the panel's deferred list. A printable open seating checklist (reserved tables, spare seats, signage, dietary plan, venue questions) would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed. Wonderland Studio (seating chart, RSVP) is a natural fit for this topic but no page for it was confirmed, so it is not placed.
